objectives: Develop safe and reliable laboratory practice.
Quantify measurement uncertainty and communicate experimental results.

outcomes.statement: Analyse experimental data and evaluate physical models.
Prepare clear and reproducible laboratory reports.

syllabus.title: Measurement and Uncertainty
syllabus.topics: Units, calibration, random and systematic errors, uncertainty propagation.

syllabus.title: Data Analysis
syllabus.topics: Graphical methods, regression, residuals and goodness of fit.

syllabus.title: Laboratory Investigations
syllabus.topics: Mechanics, oscillations, electrical measurements and optical experiments.
